title: Storm Austen brings power cuts and travel disruption as more wind and rain forecast
description: Millions remain under yellow weather warnings for wind and rain, with a second storm expected to hit Scotland and parts of northern England on Saturday.

title: Watch: Moment part of Brighton's historic West Pier collapses
description: Footage taken during Storm Austen shows a section of the famous landmark battered by large waves and collapsing into the water.

title: Meghan says she was informed about 'disturbing allegations' against her father in 2018
description: The Duchess of Sussex issues a statement following reports her father Thomas Markle is being investigated over child sex abuse images in the Philippines.

title: Meghan statement offers answers after years of questions about her relationship with father
description: Today, without exactly using the word, Meghan claimed vindication.

title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
description: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks and the suspected gunman has been apprehended.

title: White House says Melania Trump brokers truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
description: Ukraine and Russia confirm the truce in Russian-occupied Oleshky, where residents have had to eat garden weeds to survive.

title: Bayern Munich manager Kompany taken to hospital after collapsing at training
description: Bayern Munich manager Vincent Kompany is taken to hospital after collapsing as he watched the club's second team train on Friday.

title: Burnham suggests stocking up on tinned food and bottled water
description: The prime ministers says unexpected events seem to be becoming more common and it was wise to prepare.

title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
description: The soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint outside the West Bank city on Friday morning.
